design_note.minsa: Added as engineering research candidate, not as trusted religious source.
design_note.ontology: OWL/RDF can model relationships and support SPARQL, but cannot manufacture fiqh conclusions; every derived claim remains tied to source evidence.
design_note.embeddings: Embeddings are retrieval infrastructure, not truth or authority; evidence IDs, provenance, rights and verification status must persist through retrieval.
design_note.llm: LLM weights can assist synthesis only after the evidence gate and never replace source-grounded evidence or scholar review.
design_note.arena: Arena is an optional external coding-agent worker; repository access must remain least-privilege and all changes flow through isolated branches, tests, evidence and review.
design_note.agent_fleet: Multiple agents are capability workers, not authorities. Rechercher Ω remains the orchestrator; no agent may write directly to the canonical Corpus.
design_note.islamic_graphs: Islamic knowledge-graph projects are research inputs only. Preserve source IDs, provenance, rights and uncertainty through graph construction and retrieval.
design_note.mcp_grounding: MCP servers are connector/query infrastructure, not religious authorities. Rechercher must retain source IDs, exact text, edition/language metadata, provenance, rights and retrieval evidence.
design_note.manuscript_ocr: Maghrebi and manuscript OCR resources can improve acquisition and transcription, but OCR output remains a derived artifact requiring multi-engine comparison and human/QC validation before canonical use.
